name: Nyxborn
description: Creatures with night-sky skin of many shapes, once emissaries of the gods, who attack a bridge-gate and slaughter the narrator's company.

timeline.summary: Word comes that the Nyxborn are attacking, and the narrator rushes with her company to the gate.
The Nyxborn force of mixed creatures with night-sky skin approaches the bridge, and the narrator realizes they are agents of the gods.
timeline.quote: These were agents of the gods sent to do their bidding.

timeline.summary: The narrator realizes she has rushed into battle with only seven other soldiers against an army of unknown size.
timeline.quote: I had rushed into a fight against an army of unknown size and strength with only seven other soldiers.

timeline.summary: The soldiers hold the bridge in a phalanx, knocking Nyxborn off the edge, until weak reinforcements arrive and the gates are sealed behind them.
timeline.quote: Reinforcements arrived and the guards sealed the gates behind them

timeline.summary: A Nyxborn grabs and stabs the narrator six times and throws her against the sealed gates.
timeline.quote: thrown like a child's toy against the gates that didn't open.

timeline.summary: The Nyxborn retreat after the last soldier falls, and the gates reopen.
timeline.quote: And then, as the last soldier fell, the Nyxborn retreated.

relations.note: The Nyxborn attack and slaughter the Akroan company.

pages_say.description: Star-skinned agents of the gods walking among mortals, growing in number monthly.
Creatures with night-sky skin of many shapes, once emissaries of the gods, who attack a bridge-gate and slaughter the narrator's company.
Beings who serve and guide mortals again after Xenagos's defeat.
